observations.body: Moses argues that Egypt and the land’s inhabitants know the LORD is present with Israel and will hear if Israel is killed together.
observations.label: Moses appeals to the LORD’s name and reputation among the nations: action

observations.body: He asks for the LORD’s power to be great according to the proclaimed character that forgives yet does not clear guilt.
observations.label: Moses appeals to the LORD’s name and reputation among the nations: response

observations.body: Egypt will hear · seen face to face · slow to anger · abundant loving kindness · pardon

payload.posture: Read Numbers 14:13–19 as refusal, intercession, pardon, and sentence evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Moses repeats both forgiveness and accountability, so his plea does not erase the tension between pardon and consequence.
